items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: But that was my trumpet section. They were great. I had Omer Simeon (unintelligible) with me. ... This is when I had Walter Fuller, trumpet, Ray Nance, and I had a little guy from Ohio named PeeWee Jackson, Harry Jackson.

ctx.x: Oh I see, in the same job down there.

Same job in San Diego, cause Walter Fuller was a great trumpet player and a salesman. He was in Earl Hines' band when Earl went to New York and broke it up at the Apollo Theater, and his favorite tune that he did was "Rosetta." Do you remember Earl Hines made a record of that, "Rosetta," and of course Walter Fuller had a little baby girl and he named her "Rosetta." And of course, he sang it and played and he was a great musician.
What do you mean when you say salesman? He would --
